defaultPrompt: Explain this homework problem step by step, check my attempt, and save a worked example plus three practice questions.
Turn these biology notes into a study guide, a 15-question practice quiz with explanations, and a set of flashcards.
Create a one-week exam review plan from these chapters and save a printable worksheet for the topics I find hardest.
interface.longDescription:
Julius is an AI homework helper, study guide maker, and AI tutor for coursework and self-study. Turn the problems, readings, and notes you provide into step-by-step explanations, worked examples, practice quizzes, and flashcard sets you can save and revisit.

Get homework help that builds understanding:

- Homework and assignment help: Break a problem into manageable steps, explain unfamiliar concepts, check your work, identify mistakes, and create a similar practice problem with an answer key.

- Study guides and notes: Summarize class notes, assigned readings, chapters, and supported text-based PDFs into revision notes, definitions, key ideas, and a structured study guide.

- Quiz and practice test generator: Create multiple-choice, short-answer, and practice questions from your course material. Add explanations, vary difficulty, and build a printable worksheet or mock exam.

- Flashcard maker: Turn notes and vocabulary into question-and-answer cards, printable flashcards, or a simple browser-based study set.

- Subject support: Work through supplied material in biology, chemistry, physics, English, history, and coding. Use Python to check calculations and create graphs for quantitative homework.

- Exam preparation: Organize topics into a study plan, revision timetable, or review checklist, and focus practice on concepts you want to strengthen.

Start with a question in chat, import an available file attachment, or continue with materials saved in your personal Julius library. Save study guides, worksheets, and answer keys as PDF, Word, Markdown, or HTML files; save flashcard sets as text or CSV. Prepared explanations become reusable study materials, with Python available when calculations or document formatting are needed.

Your saved work remains private. When you ask to share a completed study guide or practice quiz publicly, publish the saved file and receive a link. Connect your Julius account to get started.
